challenges.instruction: Look at the playground sandbox tile. What smaller shapes make up this big square?
challenges.hint: Look closely! Straight lines cut across the square to make smaller shapes.
challenges.compositeDescription: A square that can be split into 2 triangles

challenges.instruction: Look at the slide platform. What shapes are used to build this rectangle?
challenges.hint: Count how many identical equal-sized blocks are lined up side by side.
challenges.compositeDescription: A rectangle that can be split into 2 squares

challenges.instruction: Look at the playground clubhouse. What shapes do you see making this house?
challenges.hint: Check the walls at the bottom and the roof on the top!
challenges.compositeDescription: A square that can be split into 2 triangles

challenges.instruction: Look at the shiny kite decoration on the playground fence. What shapes make this diamond?
challenges.hint: Draw an imaginary line down the middle. What two shapes do you see meeting?
challenges.compositeDescription: A diamond that can be split into 2 triangles

challenges.instruction: Look at this larger sandbox area. What shapes make up this big rectangle?
challenges.hint: Count all the equal square paving stones inside the play area.
challenges.compositeDescription: A rectangle that can be split into 2 squares

challenges.instruction: Look at this grand playground tower. What shapes make up this house figure?
challenges.hint: Find the main base room and the pointy roof above it.
challenges.compositeDescription: A square that can be split into 2 triangles
